202718c6-525e-4cec-a469-c945548cacc3.title: Anta to Osananajimi tte dake demo Iya nanoni! ~Zekkou kara Hajimaru S-kyuu Bishoujo to no Gakuen Nariagari Seikatsu~
202718c6-525e-4cec-a469-c945548cacc3.altTitle: I Hate That We're Childhood Friends!: My Rise to the Top of School Life with an S-Rank Beauty Begins After a Falling-Out
202718c6-525e-4cec-a469-c945548cacc3.description:
Kazuma Suzuki hanyalah siswa SMA biasa—sampai sahabat masa kecilnya, Rua Takayashiki, seorang gadis cantik berlidah tajam yang juga merupakan cucu dari kepala sekolah dan idola nasional, memutuskan semua hubungan dengannya menggunakan dialog yang diambil dari sebuah drama.

Dipaksa tunduk selama bertahun-tahun sebagai apa yang disebut sahabat masa kecilnya, Kazuma memutuskan bahwa inilah saatnya untuk pemberontakan pertamanya. Ia sudah selesai menjadi anjing piaraan. Kali ini, ia mengambil kembali kebebasannya—dan mengincar kehidupan sekolah yang normal.

Melarikan diri dari wanita cantik yang kuat seperti dia lebih mudah diucapkan daripada dilakukan...

4141c5dc-c525-4df5-afd7-cc7d192a832f.title: Blue Lock
4141c5dc-c525-4df5-afd7-cc7d192a832f.description:
After a disastrous defeat at the 2018 World Cup, Japan’s team struggles to regroup. But what’s missing? An absolute Ace Striker, who can guide them to the win. 

The Japan Football Union is hell-bent on creating a striker who hungers for goals and thirsts for victory, and who can be the decisive instrument in turning around a losing match... and to do so, they’ve gathered 300 of Japan’s best and brightest youth players. 

Who will emerge to lead the team... and will they be able to out-muscle and out-ego everyone who stands in their way?
___

**Notes:**
- **Won the 45th Kodansha Manga Award for Shonen in 2021**

31ba8a40-25c9-4efb-b5e7-f35de0ee2530.title: Maids of Order
31ba8a40-25c9-4efb-b5e7-f35de0ee2530.description:
In a world where sword-wielding maids first emerged as a trend among the aristocracy, their extraordinary swordsmanship soon turned them into bodyguards and, later, defenders of crime-ridden cities. 

After being dismissed from the mansions where they served, many found a new reason to fight and joined forces to protect the people.

0ca5bda2-0567-4529-963f-4136a098d4aa.title: Zense wa Reikoku Koutei, Konse wa Youjo
0ca5bda2-0567-4529-963f-4136a098d4aa.altTitle: In My Past Life I Was the Cold-Hearted Emperor, in This Life I'm a Young Girl
0ca5bda2-0567-4529-963f-4136a098d4aa.description:
"Juliana, your fiancé has been decided.”
At that moment, the frail daughter of an earl awakened to a shocking truth—within her resided the soul of the infamous "Cold-Hearted Emperor" Julius. A man whose ruthless conquests left behind mountains of corpses and an empire under his iron rule. 

Now, reborn as a delicate young noble girl, Julius finds himself in a seemingly peaceful era. But beneath the surface lurk corruption, poverty, and disease, all exploited by scheming villains. With the wisdom and might of a former emperor, Juliana will not stand idly by. The young lady who once ruled as a tyrant is ready to cleanse the empire once more—this time, with her tiny hands. 

A dark yet thrilling tale of power, justice, and a battle against the hidden evils of the empire begins!

dd13dad6-7cda-46cf-8d4f-13adfc6c37d6.title: Shihai Shoujo Kubaru-chan
dd13dad6-7cda-46cf-8d4f-13adfc6c37d6.description:
After fierce bullying, Yuuto Kiba wanted to die. On the verge of committing suicide, his fate changes rapidly when a strange and funky beautiful girl, Kubaru, tells him, “Give me your life”.

Make your life happy with love?! A slightly strange and psycho love drama.

86209d1b-8d66-44b1-86e5-912e07f040fe.title: Tank Knight Portriss
86209d1b-8d66-44b1-86e5-912e07f040fe.description: Portriss World is known as the home planet where robotic beings called Portriss live in peace. But the harmony was disrupted when the sudden presence of a dictator named Dark Portriss plans to take over the world. Now it's up to the Portriss Knights Karot, Duke, brothers Dig Dug, and Yuma, a mysterious human boy, to battle the evil forces and maintain peace throughout the Portriss World.

201a6ac5-3a49-44b2-af0c-1e6666ae47ed.title: Black Winter
201a6ac5-3a49-44b2-af0c-1e6666ae47ed.description:
One dark winter night, a boy was cursed and a girl was guilty.  
  
One fresh winter day,   
she sinned, and I also sinned.   
He said that if you commit a crime that night, you will receive a terrifying penalty.   
Was this the biggest punishment we would receive for breaking the taboo?   
I had to kill my loved ones…   
And I had to die at the hands of my loved ones.   
Crime and Punishment.   
Love and death as the two names make up a perfect match .  
  
You and I have suffered the most perfect punishment.  

---
13-year old Haesa watched as her world fell apart. Within a day, her best friends Muho, Muha, and Hwaye were gone, leaving her utterly alone in the cold winter forest—until she meets him.  
10 years later, can Haesa reunite with those she's lost, and uncover the truth of what really happened that fateful day?

24a60c56-373e-4b03-854f-b4c2a093f074.title: Project Mars
24a60c56-373e-4b03-854f-b4c2a093f074.description:
A drifter who lost his family to aliens as a child.
He possesses the rare ability to manipulate black holes but keeps it hidden.
One day, aliens attack the city in a terrorist act,
and when he faces them again, they threaten his life...
"Sorry, but I can't die for you. Do you know what I went through to survive?"

6576ac4c-0251-4978-ace8-70c675cb3b86.title: Fuan no Tane*
6576ac4c-0251-4978-ace8-70c675cb3b86.description: In the beginning, this place held human memories. Sad memories. As time passes, those hidden memories occasionally emerge into the everyday as strange sights. Why? Perhaps it's the cry of a spokesperson who knows the sadness, or perhaps... When something feels wrong in a place of sadness, the seeds of anxiety begin to sprout again.
